text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Kuwait's press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Britain reaffirms commitment to the security of Kuwait during visit by Defence Minister Sheikh Salem Sabah al-Salem al-Sabah to London. Britain played a key role in the U.S.-led 1991 Gulf War that ended Iraq's occupation of the Gulf Arab state.

- Kuwait Investment Authority (KIA) team to meet on Thursday to discuss privatising domestic firms. KIA, the state investment arm, has sold since 1994 stakes in some 18 local firms for over $2 billion in the first phase of the plan which also involves 36 concerns worth $3 billion.
- Official says funding needed for a project to increase production from fish farms.
- Kuwait Stock Exchange index rose 12.4 points on Tuesday to 2,067.3.
